duas.title: After Wearing Clothes
duas.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ كَسَانِيْ هٰذَا الثَّوْبَ ، وَرَزَقَنِيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِّنِّيْ وَلَا قُوَّةٍ.
duas.transliteration: Alḥamdu li-llāhi-l-ladhī kasānī hādha-th-thawb, wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawli-m-minnī wa lā quwwah.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, without any power or might from me.
duas.virtue:
## Narration

Muʿādh b. Anas (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said:

duas.title: When Wearing New Clothes
duas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيْهِ ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma laka-l-ḥamdu Anta kasawtanīhi, as'aluka min khayrihī wa khayri mā ṣuniʿa lahu, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihī wa sharri mā ṣuniʿa lahu.
duas.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You Alone — You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good of that for which it was made; and I seek Your protection from its evil and the evil of that for which it was made.
duas.virtue:
## Hadith

Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) reported that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a new garment he would name it: either a **turban**, a **shirt**, or a **cloak**; and then he would say [the above].

*(Tirmidhī 1767)*

duas.title: To be Said to Someone Wearing New Clothes
duas.translation: May you wear it out and may Allah replace it (with another).
duas.virtue:
## Narration

Abū Naḍrah said: When any of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ put on a new garment, \[the above\] was said to him. (Abū Dāwūd 4020)
